# fakecloud_tictactoe_board (Resource)

A tic-tac-toe board — the one primitive every fakecloud lesson is built on. Mark cells by creating fakecloud_tictactoe_move resources; destroying the board clears it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fakecloud_tictactoe_board" "lesson" {
  name = "my-first-board"
}

# A refereed two-player board: X starts, turns alternate, locks on a win.
resource "fakecloud_tictactoe_board" "versus" {
  name = "x-vs-o"
  mode = "duel"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the board, shown on the dashboard.

### Optional

- `mode` (String) "freeplay" (default): mark any empty cell any time — what the lessons use. "duel": the server referees a real game — X starts, turns alternate, the board locks on a win.

### Read-Only

- `cells` (List of String) Current board, 9 cells row by row; each is "", "X", or "O". Refreshed on plan/apply.
- `id` (Number) Server-assigned board id.
- `nameplate_text` (String) Text of the board's nameplate, if one exists (see fakecloud_nameplate).
- `next_player` (String) In duel mode, whose turn it is; empty in freeplay or once the game is over.
- `winner` (String) "X", "O", "draw", or empty while no line is complete.
